items.title: Cardano joins Solana, XRP Ledger in race to power AI agent payments
items.snippet: The official x402 kit now includes Cardano tools for apps and AI agents to pay with ADA and other network tokens, though the facilitator has so far only been tested on pre-production.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо SOL, XRP, ADA -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.

items.title: Trueo prediction market moves from Base to Ethereum
items.snippet: Trueo said Base was the right choice when it launched, as Ethereum gas fees were higher, but said mainnet now offers greater integration potential.
items.note: Позитивний тон для ETH за ключовими словами.

items.title: Kakao Pay, KakaoBank to explore stablecoin opportunities with Fireblocks
items.snippet: Kakao Pay and KakaoBank are exploring digital asset opportunities with Fireblocks, including infrastructure for stablecoins.
items.note: Негативний тон для загального ринку за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.

items.title: Manhattan US Attorney leading probe into Binance’s Iran compliance: Bloomberg
items.snippet: The investigation is examining whether Binance knowingly allowed trading that violated US sanctions on Iran, months after reports first revealed a Justice Department probe.
